objective_pt: Descrever a aparência e a personalidade de alguém ("She's tall and has long dark hair", "He's very friendly") e entender a diferença entre "What does she look like?" e "What is she like?".

teacher.goal_pt: Descrever alguém conhecido em uma ou duas frases e ver o vocabulário que o aluno já tem.
prompts: Who is your best friend? What does he or she look like?
Are you more like your mother or your father?
watchFor: "She has the hair long" (ordem do português); em inglês o adjetivo vem antes: "long hair".
"Hairs" no plural para o cabelo da cabeça; "hair" fica no singular.

exercises.prompt: My sister is tall and has long dark hair.
accepted: My sister is tall and has long dark hair
My sister's tall and has long dark hair

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O cabelo da cabeça é "hair", sem "s". "Hairs" são fios soltos.
commonErrors.correction_en: My sister is tall and has long dark hair.

exercises.instruction_pt: "What does she look like?" pergunta sobre:
exercises.explanation_pt: "What does she look like?" é como ela é fisicamente. "What is she like?" é como ela é de personalidade.

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Ele tem olhos azuis e cabelo curto."
accepted: He has blue eyes and short hair
He's got blue eyes and short hair
He has got blue eyes and short hair
He has short hair and blue eyes
He's got short hair and blue eyes

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês o adjetivo vem antes do substantivo: "blue eyes", "short hair".
commonErrors.correction_en: He has blue eyes and short hair.
He has blue eyes and short hair.
He has blue eyes and short hair.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender adjetivos de aparência e personalidade: curly, beard, slim, outgoing, shy, nice, polite.
prompts: Who in your family has curly hair?
Describe your boss in two words.
watchFor: "Sympathetic" para "simpático"; em inglês é compreensivo, solidário. Simpático é "nice" ou "friendly".
"Educated" para "educado"; em inglês é ter estudo. Educado (cortês) é "polite".

exercises.example_en: My brother is very outgoing. He talks to everyone.
She has curly red hair and green eyes.
The children were very polite to the guests.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao seu significado.
Diga em inglês: "A minha vizinha é muito simpática."
accepted: My neighbor is very nice
My neighbour is very nice
My neighbor is very friendly
My neighbour is very friendly
My neighbor is really nice
My neighbor is really friendly
My neighbor is so nice
My neighbor is very kind

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falso cognato: "sympathetic" é compreensivo, solidário. "Simpático" é "nice" ou "friendly".
"Neighborhood" é o bairro. A pessoa que mora ao lado é "neighbor".

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar o "h" soprado de "hair" e "height", e o "r" de "curly" e "beard".
prompts: Say "hair" and "air". Can you hear the difference?
watchFor: Pronunciar o "h" de "hair" como "r" forte; é só um sopro.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. O "h" de "he", "has" e "hair" é só um sopro.
exercises.prompt: He has short hair and a beard.
accepted: He has short hair and a beard
He's got short hair and a beard

exercises.instruction_pt: Repita. Em "medium height", "height" soa "hait" (o "h" é um sopro e o "gh" é mudo).
exercises.prompt: She's of medium height and quite slim.
accepted: She's of medium height and quite slim
She is of medium height and quite slim

teacher.goal_pt: Identificar uma pessoa pela descrição e responder sobre aparência e personalidade.
prompts: What does your father look like?
watchFor: Responder "What is she like?" com aparência em vez de personalidade.
"She is like tall" misturando as duas perguntas.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça a descrição e escolha quem é o Daniel.
exercises.listen: Daniel is in his thirties. He's quite tall, he's bald, and he wears glasses. He's very funny.
options: Um homem de uns trinta e poucos anos, alto, careca, de óculos e engraçado.
Um homem de uns trinta anos, baixo, de cabelo cacheado e tímido.
Um homem de uns treze anos, alto, de barba e sério.
exercises.explanation_pt: "In his thirties" é entre 30 e 39 anos. "Bald" é careca, "wears glasses" é usa óculos, e "funny" é engraçado.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda: ela é baixa e tem cabelo cacheado.
exercises.listen: What does your sister look like?
accepted: She's short and has curly hair
She is short and has curly hair
She's short and she has curly hair
She's short with curly hair
She's short and she's got curly hair
She's short and has got curly hair
She is short, with curly hair
She's quite short and has curly hair

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para pessoas, "baixa" é "short". "Low" é para coisas: "a low table".
commonErrors.correction_en: She's short and has curly hair.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: O adjetivo vem antes e "hair" fica no singular: "curly hair".
commonErrors.correction_en: She's short and has curly hair.
She's short and has curly hair.

exercises.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda sobre a personalidade: ele é tímido, mas muito gentil.
accepted: He's shy, but very kind
He is shy, but very kind
He's a bit shy, but very kind
He's quite shy, but really kind
He's shy but really nice
He's shy, but he's very kind
He's shy but very nice
He's a little shy, but very kind

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Timid" existe, mas o comum para "tímido" é "shy".
"What is he like?" pergunta a personalidade, não a aparência.

teacher.goal_pt: Descrever uma pessoa importante: aparência, personalidade e por que gosta dela.
prompts: What is your best friend like?
Who do you look like in your family?
watchFor: "I look like my mother" (parecer fisicamente) está certo; "I seem my mother" não.
"She has 30 years" em vez de "She's 30" ou "She's in her thirties".
"He is educated" querendo dizer "educado"; o certo é "polite".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu sou parecido com o meu pai."
accepted: I look like my father
I look like my dad
I take after my father
I take after my dad
I'm like my father
I'm like my dad
I'm similar to my father
I look a lot like my father

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Ser parecido com" é "look like" (aparência) ou "take after". "Seem" é parecer (impressão).
Use "look like" ou "similar to", e não "with".

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Ela tem uns quarenta anos e é muito educada."
accepted: She's about forty and very polite
She's about forty and she's very polite
She is about forty and very polite
She's in her forties and very polite
She's in her forties and she's very polite
She's around forty and very polite
She's about 40 and very polite
She's about forty years old and very polite

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Idade em inglês usa "be": "She's about forty".
commonErrors.correction_en: She's about forty and very polite.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falso cognato: "educated" é ter estudo. "Educada" (cortês) é "polite".
commonErrors.correction_en: She's about forty and very polite.

exercises.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa para formar a frase.
accepted: She has beautiful long black hair

exercises.instruction_pt: Descreva para a Sam uma pessoa de quem você gosta muito.
exercises.prompt_en: I want to know more about the people in your life. Can you describe someone you really like? What does this person look like, and what is he or she like?
guidelines_pt: Diga quem é e a idade: "My best friend Lucas is in his thirties."
Descreva a aparência: altura, cabelo, olhos ("He's tall and has...").
Descreva a personalidade com 2 adjetivos e diga por que gosta: "He's funny and kind. I like him because...".

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar a ordem adjetivo + substantivo e os falsos cognatos de personalidade.
prompts: What does your favorite actor look like?

exercises.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Como ele é? Ele é engraçado?"
accepted: What is he like? Is he funny?
What's he like? Is he funny?
What is he like? Is he fun?
What's he like? Is he a funny guy?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "How is he?" pergunta se ele está bem. Para personalidade, use "What is he like?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What's he like? Is he funny?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na pergunta, "is" vem antes de "he": "Is he funny?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What's he like? Is he funny?

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete a pergunta sobre a aparência.
accepted: like

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A expressão é "look like": "What does he look like?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What does your brother look like?

exercises.explanation_pt: Os adjetivos vêm antes do substantivo (tamanho antes de cor), e "hair" fica no singular.

exercises.prompt: He's really outgoing and always makes me laugh.
accepted: He's really outgoing and always makes me laugh
He is really outgoing and always makes me laugh
